executiveSummary: GM0037 Stadskanaal was the first lexicographically pending municipality with an absent artifact in audits/manifest.json and was confirmed unclaimed by the other live municipality agents. The official/generated 2025 identity, 32,038 residents, 27 neighbourhoods in five districts, six BAG woonplaatsen, 25 BRT settlement labels and seven logical road-border records are coherent. Neighbourhood rows total 32,050 residents, twelve above the municipality control (+0.037%); the allocator reconciles this independent CBS rounding without overwriting published rows. All ten presets run deterministically at T+0/6/12/24/48/72 across eight services, with bounded values, service-layer-invariant hazard, exact no-event behavior, causal-ledger closure and monotone event-attributable burden. Release is nevertheless correction-required. The Rhine/Meuse/IJssel preset is exactly zero in GM0037 through T+72, but that narrow result does not model the locally governed Stadskanaal, Mussel-Aa/Pagediep and Veenkoloniën water systems, thirteen public level areas, drought-dependent IJsselmeer supply or the municipality's published extreme-rain footprint. The pluvial preset instead publishes exactly 0.279242 m at T+12 and T+24 without using those catchments, levels, sewers or 249 partial public water objects. Eight materially different nonzero T+24 hazards reuse exactly the same complete neighbourhood rank. The canonical wildfire produces zero direct fire and only remote Veluwe smoke despite a documented major nature fire in Musselkanaal; a controlled local ignition at the representative point of Onstwedde Buitengebied Noord ranks that source neighbourhood last. The fixed Groningen earthquake gives 0.067279 g at T+6 without selecting a KNMI event, shakemap or vulnerability surface; the lack of a GM0037 event point in the bounded 365-day feed is NoData, not zero risk. ProRail geometry names Stadskanaal Hoofdstation and Musselkanaal-Valthermond, but ProRail describes Veendam–Stadskanaal as a museum railway under study for future passenger activation; these are not current regular passenger-rail continuity. Refaja is a limited-hours week hospital and basisspoedpost, not a 24/7 SEH, and directs life-threatening/complex cases to Emmen, while the simulator has no destination-specific care routing. Seven N366/N365/N374/N378 border records and 108 scheduled bus stop areas are static context, not incident throughput. The HWH snapshot's 221 weirs, thirteen surface-water pumps, eight sluices, six sewer pumps and one rwzi, one Enexis planning sample, 63 antennas and 28 education locations do not establish topology, live state, backup, restoration or emergency role. No reviewed public source confirms incident-ready Stadskanaal support points, capacities, stocks or T+0–72 actions. Unknown water, road, rail, bus, hospital, utility, communications, industrial, visitor and response state remains Unknown or NoData, never safe or zero.

supports: The annual official/generated row identifies GM0037 as Stadskanaal and reports 32,038 residents, density 272/km², 26.6% aged 65-plus and 5,481 one-person households. CBS/PDOK is CC BY 4.0 and demographic context, not incident occupancy or individual vulnerability.

The municipality reference point [7.014424285258762,52.99898831423285] lies inside the generalized 2025 boundary. The outline is suitable for administrative selection and aggregation, not canal, sewer, road, rail, building or utility connectivity.

Twenty-seven neighbourhood rows in five districts sum to 32,050 residents (+12, +0.037%), 14,750 households and 8,530 independently rounded residents aged 65-plus. The model reconciles population to the municipality control without changing source observations.

BAG supplies Alteveer, Mussel, Musselkanaal, Onstwedde, Stadskanaal and Vledderveen; BRT supplies 25 locality labels. BAG/PDOK is Public Domain Mark 1.0 and BRT is CC BY 4.0; place, label and demographic provenance remains distinct.

evidenceSources.title: E02 — Municipal extreme-rain, groundwater, sewer and climate-adaptation evidence
evidenceSources.edition: Omgevingseffectrapport/stress-test appendix dated 3 September 2024; Water- en rioleringsprogramma 2026–2030 design publication dated 25 March 2026; no standard reuse licence found
supports: The official appendix contains a GM0037 stress-test map for a 160 mm in two hours event, including health, infrastructure and neighbourhood-access risk classes, and evaluates the current waterlogging situation as orange with water on streets at multiple locations. This is a scenario layer, not a current forecast.

The municipality's 2026–2030 Water- en rioleringsprogramma covers municipal duties for wastewater, runoff, groundwater and surface water and identifies future-proof sewer, rain, groundwater and pump management. The March 2026 notice was a design/public-participation publication, not evidence that all measures were complete.

The 2024 budget documents waterlogging measures from basis sewer plans for Onstwedde, Alteveer, Mussel and Vledderveen and IBA replacement. These establish differentiated local drainage mechanisms, not an exact municipal inundation depth or operating state.

The municipal safety page lists power failure, flooding, extreme weather and earthquake as events for which residents should prepare, routes instructions through NL-Alert/municipal and regional media, and says residents may initially be on their own. It does not publish support-point capacity or activation state.

evidenceSources.publisher: Waterschap Hunze en Aa's / Het Waterschapshuis
evidenceSources.title: E03 — Stadskanaal and Veenkoloniën water-control, drought, water-quality and partial asset context
evidenceSources.edition: Waterbeheerprogramma 2022–2027 and Stadskanaal peilbesluit; current drought update 10 August 2026; HWH snapshot retrieved 3 September 2026
supports: The water board distinguishes Mussel Aa–Pagediep, Westerwoldse Aa and Kanalen Hunze–Veenkoloniën. Its technical documents describe rapid drainage in wet periods, IJsselmeer-water import in dry periods, loss of natural sponge behavior and regulated stream/canal levels.

The Stadskanaal peilbesluit defines thirteen named level areas and controls, including Spoorstraat, Rode Loper, Nautilusweg, Sluis 2, Veenhuizerstukken, Pageplas, De Renne and Broeklanden. Several levels may fall during dry periods; a fixed target level is not a live observation.

On 10 August 2026 Hunze en Aa's reported continuing drought, high demand and IJsselmeer-water import via Dorkwerd, H. Küpers, V.M. Vennix in Stadskanaal and Ter Apelkanaal. That dated regional observation is not current state at audit completion or a T+72 exercise forecast.

A documented treatment failure at Avebe Ter Apelkanaal sent insufficiently treated wastewater into the Mussel-Aa-kanaal and caused fish mortality between Harpel and Onstwedde. This historical cross-boundary water-quality pathway is not current contamination or potable-water evidence.

The partial HWH assignment contains 249 points: 221 weirs, thirteen surface-water pumps, eight sluices, six sewer pumps and one rwzi. CC BY-SA 4.0 objects do not establish complete topology, compatible capacity units, telemetry, live state, power, backup or restoration; null stays Unknown.

evidenceSources.title: E04 — Local nature-fire response and first-72-hour preparedness context
evidenceSources.edition: Incident account published 2023; regional preparedness booklet published November 2025; current pages inspected 3 September 2026; no standard reuse licence found
supports: VR Groningen records simultaneous major nature fires in Musselkanaal and Ter Apel. The Musselkanaal response used crews from multiple Groningen and Drenthe posts, specialist nature-fire units, a drone and four-wheel-drive vehicles because the area was difficult to access. This proves local direct-fire eligibility and regional resource dependence, not present ignition or probability.

The regional 72-hour booklet explains that emergency services cannot be everywhere at once, gives an example power-failure sequence through T+72 and expects households to prepare. It is preparedness guidance, not measured household stocks or guaranteed government response time.

Public fire-station/specialism material identifies Stadskanaal as a base post while specialist resources can come from elsewhere. Static capability does not establish incident availability, travel time, water supply, crew, fuel or simultaneous-demand capacity.

No reviewed public source confirms named incident-ready GM0037 emergency support points, opening triggers, capacities, stocks, generators, potable water, accessibility or staff. Ordinary schools, municipal sites and care sites must not be promoted automatically.

evidenceSources.title: E05 — Museum railway, future passenger-rail proposal, provincial roads and scheduled bus context
evidenceSources.edition: ProRail page updated 11 August 2026; NWB-Light 1 August 2026; OVapi deployment snapshot retrieved 3 September 2026; CC0 for NWB/ProRail generated transport context
supports: ProRail describes Veendam–Stadskanaal as a museum railway. Reuse for regular passenger trains is under MIRT exploration as part of the Nedersaksenlijn, and the future route/stations are not final. A ProRail station point therefore does not prove current regular passenger service.

The generated ProRail geometry query names Stadskanaal Hoofdstation and Musselkanaal-Valthermond inside GM0037, while the current scheduled network is represented by 108 GTFS stop areas led by Stadskanaal Busstation. Geometry and timetable context do not prove incident operation, vehicle capacity, accessibility or evacuation role.

Seven monthly CC0 NWB border records cover N366, N365, N374 and N378 to Pekela, Westerwolde, Borger-Odoorn and Aa en Hunze. Repeated sides of the same physical corridor are series/shared and 150 values are logical scenario units, not observed throughput.

The province documents N366 as the principal Veendam–Stadskanaal–Ter Apel–German-border corridor and past diversions through N378/N379. Historical maintenance closures demonstrate alternative-route dependence but are not current restrictions.

evidenceSources.title: E06 — Refaja limited-hours hospital role and external acute-care dependency
evidenceSources.edition: Current operator pages inspected 3 September 2026; RIVM acute-care questionnaire v1.1 published 3 July 2026; operator reuse licence unstated; RIVM data CC0 1.0
supports: Treant says Refaja is a week hospital open Monday 07:00 to Friday 20:00, with a basisspoedpost Monday–Friday 08:00–22:00 for non-life-threatening cases. Life-threatening or complex acute cases go to the 24/7 SEH at Scheper in Emmen.

The Cardiac Triage Unit is open weekdays 08:00–17:00 and refers patients outside those hours to Emmen or another hospital. Holiday notices show local urgent functions can close while Scheper remains 24/7.
RIVM v1.1 assigns zero SEH questionnaire locations inside GM0037. This is consistent with Refaja not being a SEH, but does not mean no local health care, no patients or zero acute-care need.
No public evidence in scope establishes Refaja/Scheper incident occupancy, acceptance, staffing, ambulance route, power/water, medicines, generator endurance, backup or restoration.

evidenceSources.publisher: Koninklijk Nederlands Meteorologisch Instituut / Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen
evidenceSources.title: E07 — Seismic event, shakemap and hazard-map evidence semantics
evidenceSources.edition: KNMI automatically updated event catalogue; deployed 365-day snapshot retrieved 2 September 2026; KNMI CC BY 4.0; historic hazard-map v4 dated 15 June 2017
supports: KNMI's event catalogue is automatically updated and distinguishes induced and tectonic origins. Event points are source parameters, not ground-motion, damage, probability or a future scenario.

KNMI publishes event-specific shakemaps after qualifying Groningen earthquakes and historical probabilistic hazard grids as separate NetCDF products. Hazard, shaking and structural risk require different evidence and must not be conflated.

The deployed 365-day bbox snapshot contains no event origin assigned inside GM0037. That is NoData/no in-boundary origin for the bounded period, not zero shaking, zero legacy damage, structural safety or an all-clear.

Stadskanaal participates in wider Nij Begun recovery/perspective arrangements, but regional programme eligibility does not validate the canonical preset's fixed epicentre, 0.067279 g at T+6 or neighbourhood consequences.

evidenceSources.publisher: Het Waterschapshuis / Netbeheer Nederland / RDI / DUO / Rijkswaterstaat / RIVM
evidenceSources.title: E08 — Deployment-cached public operational-context coverage and NoData contract
evidenceSources.edition: HWH retrieved 3 September 2026; NBNL, RDI, DUO, Waterinfo, KNMI and RIVM snapshots retrieved 31 August–3 September 2026
supports: GM0037 has 249 partial HWH objects, one NBNL postcode/service-area sample, 63 RDI antenna installations and 28 DUO active education-use locations. HWH is CC BY-SA 4.0; DUO is Creative Commons Attribution; RDI states no standard WFS reuse licence; the NBNL exact data-product licence identifier was not found.

The Enexis SKN sample reports 113.5 MW existing withdrawal and injection capacity, null required capacity, 4.0/6.2 MW queues, 17/26 requests and four projects. It is one large-user planning lookup, not full municipal coverage, live load, outage, reserve, switching or restoration.

The 63 RDI points comprise 27 mobile, twelve fixed-link, seven broadcast, one other-mobile and sixteen amateur installations. They do not establish coverage, operator/backhaul, traffic, power/backup, availability or repair.

There is no municipality-assigned current KNMI weather station, RIVM PM2.5 point, RWS Waterinfo observation or Waterinfo forecast in the deployment snapshots. Their absence is NoData under point/polygon coverage, not zero weather, smoke, water level/discharge or safety.
DUO schools are registered education uses, not occupancy, reception, shelter, distribution, staff, stock, generator or emergency-role evidence.

notes: All six BAG woonplaats representative points lie inside the generalized boundary, but representative points do not define canal, catchment, sewer, access or fire geometry.

The municipality spans Stadskanaal/Musselkanaal's canal ribbon, rural Veenkoloniën and the more wooded/sandy Onstwedde–Smeerling side; direct water, drought, heat and fire mechanisms are spatially distinct.
Thirteen governed level areas and connected cross-boundary streams/canals require full geometry, direction, levels and control state rather than centroid distance.

scenarioMatrix.summary: All ten canonical presets execute at all six mandatory checkpoints for all eight services.
notes: Initial MUNICIPALITY_AUDIT_CODE=GM0037 pnpm audit:model passed two tests across severe-storm, pluvial-flood, river-flood, coastal-flood, heatwave, winter-storm, cyberattack, earthquake, wildfire and compound at T+0/6/12/24/48/72 for power, water, drainage, gas, telecom, mobility, facilities and supply.
Focused inline Vite runs captured the complete checkpoint trajectories and hazardSeverity ranks without creating a scratch file.

At T+24 severity / affected people-equivalent / person-hours are storm 0.052026 / 3,225 / 82,454.701; pluvial 0.201674 / 1,965 / 102,425.493; river 0 / 0 / 0; coastal 0.085722 / 0 / 59,021.927; heat 0.074286 / 20 / 60,114.672.

These are deterministic exercise indices, modeled people-equivalent and matched-no-event service person-hours—not observations, probabilities, casualties, customer outage-hours, economic loss or operator commitments.

numericalInvariants.summary: Determinism, finite bounds, exact no-event behavior, allocation, reconciliation, causal closure and cumulative-burden contracts pass.
notes: All hazards and service availability values remain finite and bounded; affected population, demand, delivery and event-attributable person-hours are non-negative.
Zero-intensity runs have exact zero event hazard, affected population and attributable burden; T+24 repeats are deterministic and cumulative burden is monotone.
All eight services allocate 27 neighbourhoods and exactly 32,038 residents; demand/delivery reconcile and changing service layer leaves physical hazard unchanged.
Arithmetic validity does not validate water, fire, seismic, route, care, utility, action or recovery meaning.

spatialPlausibility.summary: Eight unrelated hazards reuse one complete source-insensitive neighbourhood rank and the direct-fire allocator fails a local containment test.
notes: Storm, pluvial, coastal, heat, winter, cyber, wildfire and compound have exactly the same complete nonzero T+24 rank: Stadskanaal Noord, Ceresdorp and Stadskanaal Noord Landskant lead; Alteveer, Dideldom and Onstwedde Buitengebied Noord end it.

A controlled wildfire centered on the official representative point of Onstwedde Buitengebied Noord gives that source neighbourhood rank 27/27 while Stadskanaal Noord leads. Source geometry therefore does not drive local allocation.
The canonical Veluwe wildfire produces zero GM0037 direct-fire intensity and only 0.193699 remote smoke at T+24 despite official local direct-fire evidence.
Pluvial depth, drought, canal/stream levels, heat, smoke, seismic shaking and cyber targets require different source and coverage geometry; an identifier seed cannot validate any of them.

serviceDependencies.summary: Exact water, drainage, power, telecom, care, mobility and supply trajectories lack complete causal topology and live state.
notes: NWB routes affect mobility and assumed road supply only, correctly avoiding physical utility equivalence, but repeated corridor sides and scenario capacities remain logical proxies.
HWH points do not connect rain, sewers, IBA, rwzi, thirteen level areas, streams/canals, imported IJsselmeer water, pump/sluice/weir state, power/backup or potable-water quality/pressure.
NBNL, RDI, DUO, ProRail, GTFS and RIVM records do not provide complete feeders, pipes, backhaul, live traffic/load, priority, hospital acceptance, stock, staff, backup or restoration.

At compound T+72 the model holds flood depth 0.288765 m and availability power 0.306651, water 0.353450, drainage 0.306977, telecom 0.225339, mobility 0.757500, facilities 0.310286 and supply 0.665109. No operator validates these exact values.

causalTrace.summary: The numerical ledger closes, but locally relevant event selection, evidence time, destinations and accountable actions are absent from the causal graph.
notes: Hazard contributions sum to severity, service-stage contributions reconstruct availability and municipality pressure closes numerically.

The river preset is exactly zero and selects no Stadskanaal/Mussel-Aa/Pagediep/Kanalen Hunze–Veenkoloniën boundary, level area, structure state or local footprint; pluvial selects no official stress-test cell, sewer, groundwater or receiving-water state.

Earthquake selects a fixed epicentre rather than a KNMI event/shakemap and vulnerability evidence; wildfire selects a remote source rather than local ignition/perimeter/fuel/access; cyber selects no named target or detection.

T+0–6 needs event/source selection, warning and verification; T+6–24 closures, fire/water control, care routing and support activation; T+24–48 welfare, water quality, access, utility repair and resupply; T+48–72 verified restoration, re-entry and unresolved-needs review.

recovery72h.summary: Exact recovery, persistence and operational labels are unsupported by action/resource evidence.
notes: Pluvial depth is 0.279242 m at T+12/T+24 and exactly zero at T+48; status becomes operational at T+72 with 231,762.400 deprived person-hours. No drainage action or measured recession supports this clock.

Earthquake ground motion is 0.067279 g at T+6 and zero by T+12, yet affected people-equivalent remains 3,613 at T+24. Without a selected event, damage inspection or repair action this consequence/recovery path is not operational evidence.

Compound holds 0.288765 m through T+72, remains critical with 19,849 affected people-equivalent and reaches 1,274,902.630 person-hours, but no water-control, utility, access, care or support action explains the plateau.
River's exact zero is narrowly valid only as model output for the named distant major rivers; it cannot be rendered as a local surface-water all-clear.

findings.summary: The exact-zero major-river screen omits Stadskanaal's locally relevant canal, stream, level-control and drought-supply mechanisms.
findings.evidence: The Rhine/Meuse/IJssel preset is exactly zero at all six checkpoints. E03 documents the Stadskanaal, Mussel-Aa/Pagediep, Kanalen Hunze–Veenkoloniën, thirteen level areas, IJsselmeer import and wet/dry control dependencies. Zero for the narrowly named major rivers does not establish zero local high water, waterlogging, water shortage or water-quality impact.
findings.action: Retain zero only as not-applicable direct forcing for the named Rhine/Meuse/IJssel source, never as an all-clear. Add separately selectable Hunze en Aa's canal/stream/level-area wet and dry events with governed boundary conditions, controls, footprints, valid times, uncertainty and explicit NoData.

findings.summary: The 0.279242 m pluvial output is unsupported local hydraulic precision.
findings.evidence: The model holds 0.279242 m at T+12 and T+24, but E02's official 160 mm/two-hour stress test has cell- and receptor-specific access/health/infrastructure classes, and E03 exposes thirteen levels and partial controls. The scalar uses none of these, nor sewer, groundwater, receiving level, infiltration or pump state.
findings.action: Suppress local metres and exposure until a versioned official rain event binds duration, terrain/BGT, sewer/IBA, groundwater, surface-water level, pump/control state, cell-level footprint, arrival/recession, uncertainty, licence and NoData. Retain the current value only as a visibly synthetic stress index.

findings.summary: Eight hazard families reuse one exact neighbourhood order despite contradictory local mechanisms.
findings.evidence: At nonzero T+24, storm, pluvial, coastal, heat, winter, cyber, wildfire and compound share the full rank from Stadskanaal Noord to Onstwedde Buitengebied Noord. E02–E04 distinguish urban rain, regulated water, drought, canal pollution, rural/nature fire and difficult access; cyber requires a named target rather than physical geography.
findings.action: Replace region-id scaling with event/source/coverage-aware fields. Require regression tests proving mechanism-specific order, service-layer invariance, source containment, official zero preservation and explicit Unknown outside evidence coverage.

findings.summary: The canonical remote-smoke preset does not exercise GM0037's documented direct nature-fire pathway and local allocation ignores the ignition.
findings.evidence: E04 records a major nature fire in Musselkanaal requiring specialist crews, drone and four-wheel-drive access. Canonical T+24 wildfire gives direct intensity 0 and smoke 0.193699 from a Veluwe epicentre. A controlled local ignition at Onstwedde Buitengebied Noord's representative point produces direct fire 0.466371 municipally yet ranks the source neighbourhood 27/27.
findings.action: Add controlled local ignition/perimeter, fuel/moisture, wind/plume, road/terrain, water-source and responder-resource inputs. Until authority data is selected, show remote smoke and local direct-fire exercises separately and withhold neighbourhood fire consequences.

findings.summary: The fixed Groningen earthquake publishes unsupported GM0037 ground motion and consequence precision.
findings.evidence: The canonical fixed epicentre yields 0.067279 g at T+6, 3,613 affected people-equivalent at T+24 and 294,013.389 deprived person-hours by T+72. E07 distinguishes event origins, shakemaps, probabilistic hazard and structural vulnerability. No deployed 365-day KNMI origin lies inside GM0037; that bounded absence neither validates the synthetic value nor proves safety.
findings.action: Require an event/replay mode with KNMI origin, magnitude/depth/revision, event-specific shakemap grid and valid time, plus governed building/infrastructure vulnerability. Label historic probabilistic hazard separately and suppress exact damage/service consequences without vulnerability evidence.

findings.summary: Refaja's limited-hours role and external 24/7 acute-care route are absent from Facilities and Mobility.
findings.evidence: E06 says Refaja is a weekday week hospital with a weekday basisspoedpost and CTU; life-threatening/complex cases go to Scheper Emmen. Zero RIVM SEH points in GM0037 means no registered local SEH, not no health care. Exact facility availability and recovery ignore opening hours, patient type, ambulance route and external acceptance.
findings.action: Represent facility roles and schedules separately; route urgent and complex care to incident-confirmed destinations over time-valid roads. Keep occupancy, acceptance, staff, power/water, medicine, generator fuel and restoration Unknown until authorized evidence supplies them.

findings.summary: Museum-rail station points, scheduled bus stops and seven road-border proxies are not an operational multimodal network.
findings.evidence: E05 says Veendam–Stadskanaal is a museum railway and future passenger activation/Nedersaksenlijn remains under study. ProRail geometry nevertheless names two stations; GTFS has 108 stop areas. Seven N366/N365/N374/N378 records are shared physical-corridor boundaries with 150 scenario units. None establishes current train/bus/road vehicles, direction, internal reachability, closure or capacity.
findings.action: Type the two stations as heritage/non-regular passenger service unless a current operator timetable says otherwise. Add current bus/road state, internal connector and destination-specific access for Refaja/Scheper, fire/water controls, six woonplaatsen and resupply; shared corridor sides remain non-additive.

findings.summary: Surface-water control, sewer/wastewater and drinking-water quantity/quality are collapsed into generic Water and Drainage.
findings.evidence: E03's historical Avebe failure propagated pollution cross-boundary into the Mussel-Aa-kanaal between Harpel and Onstwedde. The 249 public objects distinguish weirs, surface pumps, sluices, sewer pumps and rwzi, but supply no complete connectivity/live state. The model cannot express surface-water contamination versus potable-water pressure/quality, sewer overflow or treatment failure.
findings.action: Add separately typed surface-water level/quality, sewer overflow, wastewater treatment and drinking-water quantity/pressure/quality/advisory state. Use authority alerts and samples with valid/expiry time; never infer potable contamination from surface-water evidence or safety from missing samples.

findings.summary: Public electricity, telecom, school and water points cannot validate exact continuity or restoration.
findings.evidence: E08 provides one Enexis large-user planning sample, 63 RDI installations and 28 DUO locations; E03 provides partial water objects. These data do not expose causal feeder/pipe/backhaul topology, live load/traffic, outage, switching, priority, backup, stock, staff or repair. At compound T+72 exact service availability remains 0.225339–0.757500 without operator evidence.
findings.action: Retain registers as non-causal context. Bind only authorized outage/advisory and aggregate restoration evidence by event and valid time; otherwise display operator state, capacity, backup and recovery as Unknown and keep synthetic indices visually distinct.

findings.summary: No auditable action/resource ledger supports first-72-hour decisions, plateaus or recovery labels.
findings.evidence: E02 and E04 provide responsibilities, warnings and household guidance, not activated sites/resources. Model recovery is driven by generic preparedness/delay/multipliers. It records no source verification, warning, road/fire/water decision, Refaja/Scheper routing, support activation, welfare check, repair, resupply, water-quality action, completion or rollback.
findings.action: Add proposed/requested/confirmed/completed/blocked/cancelled actions with owner, authority source, issue/valid/expiry time, geography, dependency, resource/capacity, verification and rollback. T+0–6 verify/warn; T+6–24 protect/close/route/activate; T+24–48 inspect/repair/support/resupply; T+48–72 verify restoration/re-entry and unresolved needs.

findings.summary: Missing point coverage, publication values and operational state require explicit multi-state rendering.
findings.evidence: District heat/charging cover 0/27 and cars per household 24/27. GM0037 has no assigned Waterinfo observation/forecast, KNMI weather station, RIVM PM2.5 point, RIVM SEH or recent KNMI event origin. These are different coverage semantics and do not mean zero assets, weather, smoke, water, patients, seismic risk or incident state.
findings.action: Use one map/API/export contract distinguishing observed or modeled zero, Unknown/not covered, stale/expired and not applicable. Show publisher, edition/version, issue/observation/valid/retrieval/expiry, unit/datum, coverage, completeness, licence, confidence and affectsSimulation.

findings.summary: The deterministic numerical and semantic contract passes for GM0037 on the audited build.
findings.evidence: The focused harness passes ten presets, six checkpoints and eight services. Values are finite/bounded, zero-event behavior exact, all 27 neighbourhoods and 32,038 residents reconcile, demand/delivery and ledgers close, service selection leaves hazard unchanged, road flows stay within logical capacity and burden is monotone.

residualLimitations: This deterministic 72-hour planning stress test is not a Stadskanaal, Hunze en Aa's, VR Groningen, KNMI, ProRail, Treant, Enexis or operator forecast, warning, probability, evacuation order, casualty estimate or restoration promise.
No selected local canal/stream hydrograph, rain field, level-area/control state, sewer/groundwater state, official connected footprint, arrival, duration or recession is ingested.
The 0.279242 m pluvial property is a synthetic screening value, not observed or officially modeled local water depth and must not drive evacuation, routing, care or service thresholds.
River zero applies only to the model's named Rhine/Meuse/IJssel forcing and says nothing about Stadskanaal/Mussel-Aa/Pagediep, regional water, drought, sewer, groundwater or water quality.
The generalized boundary and centre do not resolve waterways, level areas, controls, terrain, sewers, buildings, roads, rail, nature fuels, facilities, assets, households or individuals.
CBS values are rounded/suppressed; the +12 population difference and null district-heating/charging/cars-per-household fields are publication semantics, not extra/zero people or assets.
HWH is partial and 249 points do not establish complete topology, compatible units, telemetry, usable capacity, live operation, power, backup or restoration; null remains Unknown.
The August 2026 drought report is a dated regional observation, not current exercise state or a forecast through T+72.
The Avebe canal-pollution and Musselkanaal fire accounts are historical incidents, not current conditions, recurrence probabilities or current operator failure.
No GM0037 Waterinfo observation or forecast point exists in the deployment snapshot; missing point coverage is NoData, not normal water, zero flow or safety.
No complete public causal Enexis feeder/switching, drinking-water pipe/pressure/quality, gas district, municipal sewer or telecom backhaul/restoration topology is authorized in the model.
One NBNL sample is large-user planning/queue context rather than municipal coverage, current load, outage, reserve, switching or restoration.
RDI sites do not establish coverage, traffic, ownership, backhaul, power/backup, damage, availability or restoration; the WFS standard reuse licence is unstated.
NWB, ProRail and GTFS are static geometry/schedule context and do not establish incident road, museum rail, bus, evacuation, response, care or logistics continuity.
The two ProRail station features do not establish regular passenger service; the Nedersaksenlijn remains a future project under exploration.
RIVM's zero in-boundary SEH points means no registered SEH questionnaire location, not no hospital, patients, care demand or available external acute care.
Treant public schedules do not establish present Refaja/Scheper occupancy, acceptance, staffing, ambulance access, diversion, power/water, medicines, generator fuel or backup endurance.
DUO education locations do not establish command, reception, shelter, care or distribution roles; no all-hazard GM0037 support-point capacity was confirmed.
No local KNMI weather, RIVM PM2.5 or recent seismic-origin point is available; absence is not zero exposure, ground motion, weather, smoke or safety.

The canonical wildfire lacks local ignition/perimeter/fuel/plume/resource evidence; earthquake uses a fixed source; cyber lacks named target, architecture and detection; compound combines unvalidated assumptions.
Industrial/agricultural workers, process demand, pupils, patients, museum-rail visitors and through road/bus users are not represented by resident population or generic service weights.
Household 72-hour preparedness, stock and ability to assist are not measured; 72 hours is an operations horizon, not guaranteed aid or recovery.

Event-attributable person-hours is a matched-no-event weighted availability proxy, not measured customer outage-hours, simultaneous deprivation, casualties, displacement or welfare loss; six-hour checkpoints miss fast fire, quake, water-control and medical decisions and 72 hours excludes prolonged recovery.
